during.npc: Hello! Welcome to the Twisted League. I see you are new here.

during.player: Yes, this is my first League. Can you explain how they work?

during.npc: First of all, I'm your Leagues Tutor. If you have any questions about how Leagues work, you can come to me for help.
Now, Leagues are time-limited modes that give you a new way to play the game. For this League, you are restricted to the Kourend and Kebos regions, and you play as an Iron Man.
Let's take a look at all of the information available about this League. There is a new section in the journal tab whilst on a Leagues world. Click on the flashing quest icon to take a look.
Now that you have your journal open, click on the flashing Leagues icon.
This is the Leagues menu. Here you can view your progress through the current League. You can also open the various Leagues interfaces from here.
Your objective in each League is to complete tasks and earn League Points.
Tasks are split into five difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master. The harder the task, the more points awarded.
Let's have a look at the tasks interface now. Click on the flashing button to open it.
This is the tasks interface. Here you can see all the tasks available to you in this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
Earning points during the League will allow you to unlock powerful Twisted Relics. The more League Points you have, the more Relics available to you.
League Points are also transferred over to your main profile. There, they can be spent on rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop.
Now let's have a look at the Twisted Relics. Click on the flashing button to take a look at the Relics interface.
This is the Relics interface. Here you can unlock new Twisted Relics to be used during this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
There are a few changes to Kourend and Kebos which you may not be used to. You can view all of these changes on the information interface.
Right, I think that's everything. If you need reminding of any of this information, you can either talk to me or read the information interface.
Before you head off though, it's time to pick your first Relic! Choose carefully though, once you've picked a Relic you can't go back and change your decision.

after.npc: I'm the Tutor for Old School Leagues.

steps.npc: Old School Leagues are time-limited game modes that are separate from your main profile.
With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the game mode.

steps.player: So it's a fresh start? Why would I want that?

steps.npc: Glory, gold, and the chance to play the game in a different way!
First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.
The more points you have at the end of the League, the better League Rank you will be given.
Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off how well you did.
If that doesn't interest you, how about gold! When you earn League Points, they will be transferred over to your main profile.
These points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop. You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to other players!

steps.player: And if glory and gold don't interest me?

steps.npc: Leagues aren't just a copy of the normal game. Every League has unique rules and features to set it aside from the game you're used to.
Not only that, but within each League, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics. These Relics completely change the way you play the game!
So even if glory and gold are not for you, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!

steps.player: I see, thanks for the information.

steps.npc: My pleasure!

options.text: Is there currently a League running?

steps.player: Is there currently a League running?

steps.npc: No, The most recent League was the Twisted League. You can now claim your trophies from the Twisted League and purchase rewards using your League points.
League trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League points you earned compared to everyone else who participated.
There are seven tiers of Trophy: Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, Rune and Dragon. Each League trophy has a logo on the front so you can tell which League it was awarded from.

steps.player: What are the League point cut-offs for the Twisted League?

steps.npc: Bronze trophy: 10 points, Iron trophy: 80 points, Steel trophy: 510 points, Mithril trophy: 1770 points.
Adamant trophy: 5270 points, Rune trophy: 10820 points and the Dragon Trophy: 20830 points.

steps.text: If the player has not earned any points during the Twisted League:

steps.npc: You earned 0 League points which does not qualify you for any trophy.

steps.text: If the player has earned more than 10 points during the Twisted League:

steps.npc: You earned [number] League points which qualifies you for the all of the Twisted League trophies up to and including the Twisted [type] trophy!

options.text: I'd like to claim my League trophies.
I'd like to claim my League trophies.
Can I purchase my League rewards?

steps.player: Can I purchase my League rewards?

steps.npc: Certainly, I have a number of unique rewards which you can purchase using points earned competing in a League. Here is what is available.

options.text: I'd like to claim my League trophies.

steps.player: I'd like to claim my League trophies.

steps.text: If the player has not earned any points during the Twisted League:

steps.npc: You have not earned any League trophies. If you want a League trophy you should participate next time a League comes around!

steps.text: If the player has earned points during the Twisted League:

steps.npc: Of course, here are the trophies you have earned.

steps.text: If the player does not have enough inventory space:

steps.npc: You do not have enough space for all the League trophies you can claim. Come back to me when you have more space.

steps.text: If the player has claimed all eligible trophies:

steps.npc: You have already claimed all of the League trophies which you have earned.
All the best.
